name: Avila
subject: A thin young man of about 21 with light olive skin, black hair tied up in a short punk topknot, clean-shaven, a narrow face; a scout with tired night-owl eyes and a guarded, vengeful look. He wears a work jacket over a collared shirt, a leather apron and a short wool mantle across the shoulders. Common, practical clothing, lightly weathered. Facing three-quarter left.

name: Soot
subject: A reptilian saurid woman of about 38: pale grey scaled skin, small fin-like frills where ears would be, a crest of light teal hair-like quills; slim. A former glitterworld surgeon, calm and precise, with a sharp, focused gaze. She wears a fur pelt coat over a plain T-shirt and a leather apron, a short mantle on the shoulders. Practical clothing, ordinary hardship. Facing front.

name: Ape
subject: A thin woman of about 48 with light olive skin and a short white afro; a herder raised in caves, quietly gifted, with a warm but wary look. She wears padded cloth armour under a heavy parka and a string of beads. Worn, hard-working, weathered skin. Facing three-quarter right.

name: Trorgakoc
subject: A dark elf man of about 28: pale, almost porcelain skin, long straight jet-black hair, long pointed elven ears; lean and strong. A warrior with a calm, simple, good-natured manner and a proud bearing. He wears dark leather armour over a tunic and a dark cape. Facing three-quarter left.

name: Lorena
subject: A merfolk woman of about 27 from the coast: deep brown skin, delicate fin-like ears, reddish-brown hair in a sleek swept style; slim and nimble. A sea shaman with a kind, attentive face. She wears simple sea-shaman garb with shell and cord ornaments. Facing front.

name: Darunia
subject: A dark elf woman of about 23: pale skin, long straight black hair, long pointed elven ears, a pretty, confident face with a flirtatious half smile. An archer and fire-keeper. She wears ornate dark armour with pauldrons over a quilted vest and a sheriff's shirt, a bandana around the neck. Facing three-quarter right.

name: Webb
subject: A woman of about 59 with dark brown skin and greying black hair in tight braids; tough and well travelled, a former private contractor. She wears a dark flowing robe over leather armour, a carved stone war mask hanging at her chest. Deep lines, a hard stare, a hard life. Facing three-quarter left.

name: Bautista
subject: A man of about 33 with medium tan skin and messy bright red hair, clean-shaven; a builder who became the colony's healer, quick to hold a grudge. He wears a heavy parka over a collared shirt and a scarf; a simple prosthetic arm of metal and leather shows at one shoulder. Common clothing, weathered. Facing front.

name: Ettrian
subject: A dark elf man of about 28: pale skin, black hair gathered in loose bunches, long pointed elven ears; a herder raised in a tribe, with a restless, craving look. He wears a woodland tunic and chainmail under spiked dark armour and pauldrons, a dark cape, a deer skull ornament on one shoulder. Facing three-quarter right.

name: Guido
subject: A man of about 40 with light olive skin and short dark auburn hair in a neat side part, clean-shaven; clever, gentle with animals, slightly delicate, hard-working. He wears a fur pelt coat over a collared shirt and a leather apron, a belt hung with small capture balls. Facing front.

name: Luna
subject: A little girl of about two with light tan skin and short black hair in two small ponytails, round cheeks and big curious eyes, wrapped in a small knitted wool sweater, held up close to the viewer. Facing front.
